newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ngai Lik to fund purchase by internal resources.
newsitem.headline: Ngai Lik to fund purchase by internal resources.

text.p: Consumer audio products maker Ngai Lik Industrial Holdings Ltd will fund HK$133.44 million purchase of two private motorcyle parts-making companies by internal resources and bank borrowings, the company said on Thursday.
Ngai Lik said in a statement it had agreed to buy the two private companies from a group of investors, including the company's chairman Lam Man Chan, for a total HK$133.44 million.
Lam owns 12.5 percent in each of the two companies, Hangerton Group Ltd and Litonor Technology Co Ltd, which design and trade motorcycle engine parts in China and Taiwan, Ngai Lik said.

"It is the business strategy of the company to seek for profitable and high potential industrial businesses in order to achieve a geographical diversification of its source of income and broaden the earnings base of the group," the company said.
The purchase will be completed on October 31, it said.
